description: Elections Commission - Mrs. G. W. G. Sunethra Malini of the Hambantota Municipal Council has vacated her office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - Mr. K. G. G. Sri Ananda of the Hambantota Municipal Council has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Poujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that two members of the Hambantota Municipal Council have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of their political party. This falls under Election-related processes and declarations, making it Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
